summary:
W3b (till, refund UI and tablet) is finished. An earlier, interrupted attempt of mine had already written most of the admin side. I checked every owned file against the real W1 routes (`backend/src/modules/connectors/posRoutes.ts`, `connectors/terminal/service.ts`), the W5 pre-bill shapes and the real void response from `pos/service.ts`, then finished what was missing. Admin `tsc` is clean.

**1. Card machine at the till (spec §7)**
- `tillApi.ts` calls the real `/pos/terminal/*` routes: config, start charge, follow, cancel, resolve, list a ticket's charges (`?orderId=&active=1`), and refund to card. The idempotency key for one attempt is kept in sessionStorage under `charge:<orderId>:<due>:<tip>`. The chosen card machine is remembered per browser in localStorage, inside try/catch.
- New `TerminalCharge.tsx` (dark kds styling):
  - Terminal picker and a "Charge PKR x on <label>" button.
  - Live states: insert/tap card with a countdown and Cancel, cancelling, approved and recording, declined, timed out, not charged, reversed automatically, reversal failed (manager alerted), recorded.
  - "Check the card machine" resolver for an unknown outcome: "It shows APPROVED — enter the slip reference" or "Declined / nothing". It never re-keys the charge.
  - 409 CHARGE_IN_PROGRESS resumes the charge already running. AMOUNT_MISMATCH and ALREADY_PAID reload the bill.
  - Added this session: a charge the resume query finds after the component has mounted is now followed too.
- `PaymentModal.tsx`:
  - Uses the card machine only when the company's terminal connector is on and a terminal is at this drawer.
  - Resumes an active charge when it opens. While a charge holds the order, other tenders are locked.
  - The manual-reference link appears only when the machine is offline (`online === false`) or unreachable, and only if manual references are allowed. Otherwise it is today's manual flow. It sends `manualReason: 'terminal_offline'`.
  - Handles 409 TERMINAL_CHARGE_ACTIVE.

**2. Printing**
- "Print pre-bill" (`POST /pos/orders/:id/pre-bill`, then opens `/pos/pre-bills/:id/html`) is on the payment step, each open ticket, the waiter "sent" screen, and `/orders/[id]` for open orders.
- 409 PRE_BILL_REQUIRED from the full & final print offers the pre-bill instead.
- After payment the modal shows the fiscal line from the payment's `fiscal` (or the charge view's): the filed number, "Fiscal invoice: pending — will file automatically", or a TEST badge. It polls `/pos/orders/:id/fiscal` every 5 s for 60 s and offers "Reprint with fiscal QR" once the sale is filed.
- `OrderFiscalPanel.tsx` on `/orders/[id]` shows the documents, status, number, QR (admin `qrcode`), last error, Retry (managers) and Reprint.

**3. Voids, cancels and refunds**
- `VoidLineDialog.tsx` asks for a manager PIN unless the signed-in user is one of the server's override approvers (`managerRole.ts` reads `GET /permissions/role-modules`). It sends `managerOverridePin` and shows MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED / INVALID_MANAGER_PIN plus ORDER_PARTLY_PAID, VOID_LAST_LINE, OPEN_DRAWER_REQUIRED, ALREADY_VOIDED and OVER_CAP.
- The order page updates the bill at once from the void response (totals, `removedCents`). If `splitCleared`, it tells the cashier to re-split, with a link to `/orders/:id/split`; a refund shows as "PKR x refunded by <method>".
- Cancels send a manager PIN for non-managers.
- `RefundOptions.tsx` (shared by `/refunds` and the order page) offers only the tenders the order was paid with. A single tender is the default and the blank option is hidden. It sends the evidence photo when the policy requires one, and offers refund to the card on the machine for `card_terminal` payments.
  - Fixed this session: that card-machine refund is now ticked only for managers. It is never sent for anyone else, because the route is managers-only.
- The refund-policy page says "Voids always need a manager", hides the cashier void limit and no longer sends it.
- `/refunds`: the hard-coded `#fff` is now the `bone` token.

**4. Tablet**
- `printer.ts` (already done, verified this session):
  - Pre-bill banner at top and foot; FULL & FINAL BILL heading.
  - Fiscal number plus ESC/POS QR from `fiscal`, with the legacy `fbrInvoiceNo` / `srbInvoiceNo` / `srbQrLink` as fallback. Pending and TEST lines; "Not a tax invoice".
  - 409 PRE_BILL_REQUIRED throws `PreBillRequiredError`, or prints a pre-bill when `preBillFallback` is set.
- `kds/[stationId].tsx` (new this session): line status is `'pending'|'preparing'|'held'|'recalled'`. Recalled lines get a red REMAKE label and border. Held lines show HELD in Up next and cannot be bumped.
- `kds/index.tsx` (new this session): typed item statuses, REMAKE / HELD in front of the line name (recalled counts as cooking), and a PAID chip on tickets where `/expo/queue` sends `paid: true`.

Page READMEs updated.
deviations:
- **Card refund on the machine is managers-only, with no PIN path.** POST /pos/terminal/refunds is MANAGERS only and has no PIN (fix-W1 R1). Only a manager's own session can tick "Refund to the card on the card machine". A cashier sees a note and records a refund made on the machine by hand through the normal engine. 403 MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED and OVER_CAP are shown as messages, with no PIN prompt on this flow.
- **"Reprint when filed" polls only.** It polls /pos/orders/:id/fiscal every 5 s for 60 s and does not listen for the `fiscal.filed` socket event; the till has no socket hook today.
- **The order page's fiscal panel lives in `components/pos/OrderFiscalPanel.tsx`**, not `components/connectors/FiscalPanel.tsx`, because components/connectors belongs to another workstream.
- **`useIsManager()` uses the server's override-approver list** from `GET /permissions/role-modules`, not the narrower MANAGERS list. While that list is loading, everyone counts as "not a manager", so the dialog asks for a PIN; the server decides either way.
- **Tablet expo PAID chip.** The chip is drawn above each OrderTicket in `kds/index.tsx`, since `src/components/OrderTicket.tsx` is not mine. REMAKE / HELD are put in front of the line name on expo, and recalled lines count as cooking.
- **Tablet station screen.** Held lines (only sent with `?states=all`, which the tablet does not request) are typed, shown as HELD in Up next and cannot be bumped.
- **Waiter screen.** The waiter "sent" screen keeps its existing ✅ / ⏳ icons, which this workstream did not add. No new UI uses emoji.
